title: Narrowing the Range
subtitle: A machine-checked refinement of the CMV four-arc bound

cmv_source.bibliography: A. Cañete, M. Miranda Jr., and D. Vittone, Some Isoperimetric Problems in Planes with Density, Journal of Geometric Analysis 20 (2010), 243–290; arXiv:0906.1256.

claims.title: Certified modeled range reduction
claims.statement: For every explicitly modeled FourArcCandidate satisfying the recorded CMV type-(iv) hypotheses, weighted-perimeter minimality implies 1 < λ < 1.2581840884.
details: At or above the inclusive cutoff, Lean derives a contradiction from exact area preservation and strict weighted-perimeter improvement.

claims.title: Source-facing conclusion is conditional
claims.statement: The exported Lean theorem quantifies over FourArcCandidate, not over arbitrary finite-perimeter subsets of the plane. Applying it to every source-level CMV type-(iv) minimizer additionally requires CMV's candidate reduction and a source-to-coordinate reduced-boundary correspondence.
details: This report does not claim the full CMV conjecture and does not claim existence of a type-(iv) minimizer below the cutoff.

claims.title: Strip-density problem
claims.statement: CMV study the planar density equal to 1 on |y| ≤ 1 and λ outside the strip, with λ > 1, using weighted area and reduced-boundary weighted perimeter.
details: The interface itself has density 1 under this convention.

claims.title: Candidate reduction
claims.statement: CMV's symmetry results and Lemma 3.8 reduce vertically symmetric planar candidates to four families; type (iv) has two strip arcs and two reflected exterior arcs of equal radius.
details: Proposition 3.9 supplies vertical reflection symmetry for planar isoperimetric regions; Lemma 3.8 alone is not a theorem about every minimizer.

claims.title: Published cap substitution
claims.statement: The proof of CMV Theorem 3.16 replaces two congruent exterior caps by one doubled-area cap and an exposed chord, reducing the comparison to 2 arc(x) − arc(2x) > 1/λ.
details: CMV prove the lower bound π/4 and obtain exclusion for λ ≥ 4/π; Remark 3.17 identifies the true minimum as the sharper constant without evaluating it.

claims.title: Unit-chord circular segments
claims.statement: For half-central angle 0 < θ < π, the formal model uses arc length ℓ(θ) = θ/sin θ and area a(θ) = (θ − sin θ cos θ)/(4 sin² θ).
details: The interval includes minor, semicircular, and major circular segments.

claims.title: Positive-area inverse
claims.statement: Lean proves that area is strictly increasing on (0,π), reaches every positive area, and defines θOf on the positive branch used by arc.
details: The inverse branch, rather than an unconstrained root choice, fixes all later angle identities.

claims.title: Exact derivative of arc
claims.statement: For x > 0, Lean proves HasDerivAt arc (2 sin(θOf x)) x.
details: This follows from the inverse-area derivative and cancellation of the common positive factor sin θ − θ cos θ.

claims.title: Comparison derivative and tails
claims.statement: For g(x) = 2 arc(x) − arc(2x), Lean proves the exact derivative and proves it is negative on the small-x tail and positive on the large-x tail.
details: These strict signs force every stationary minimum into the compact middle interval.

claims.title: Unique stationary parameter
claims.statement: Lean defines θstar and proves it is the unique root on the selected interval of 3θ − 3 sin θ cos θ − π = 0.
details: The uniqueness theorem is tied to a proved strict-monotonicity argument, not a floating-point root finder.

claims.title: Global lower bound
claims.statement: Lean proves 3 cos θstar ≤ g(x) for every x > 0; this is a whole-domain theorem, not a sampled numerical minimum.
claims.display: 3 cos θ★ ≤ g(x)   for every x > 0
details: The middle-interval monotonicity and the two tail signs supply complete positive-domain coverage.

claims.title: Exact inclusive cutoff
claims.statement: The optimized Lean certificate proves 1/λ < g(x) for every x > 0 whenever 1.2581840884 ≤ λ.
details: The decimal is elaborated as an exact rational. The formal theorem uses rational trigonometric enclosures, not a floating-point oracle.

claims.title: Cap normalization
claims.statement: For the explicit FourArcCandidate coordinates, the normalized cap area capX equals area(alpha), so the scalar theorem applies to the candidate's exterior cap.
details: This is a theorem about the Lean coordinate structure; it is not by itself the source-to-model classification theorem.

claims.title: Doubled-area replacement
claims.statement: Lean proves that the inserted replacement cap has Euclidean area exactly twice the original exterior-cap area and that the resulting modeled weighted area is preserved.

claims.title: Branch-complete type-(iii) carrier
claims.statement: Lean constructs a closed coordinate carrier for every regular modeled type-(iii) profile and proves that its exterior arc is major, semicircular, or minor exactly as h is below, equal to, or above 1/2; the bottom segment degenerates exactly at h = 1/2.
details: This closes the coordinate-constructor prerequisite only. Weighted-area and complete-frontier formulas, reduced-boundary equivalence, equal-area root selection, and source normalization remain separate obligations.

claims.title: Complete Euclidean frontier costs
claims.statement: Lean identifies the component perimeter formulas for both the original and replacement coordinate carriers with canonical weighted integrals over their complete topological frontiers using the Euclidean metric.
details: The proof includes the exposed chord and treats pairwise joins as one-dimensional Hausdorff-null overlaps.

claims.title: Exact perimeter difference
claims.statement: The modeled perimeter difference factors as capChord · (1 − λ g(capX)).
details: Positivity of the chord and the certified scalar inequality make this expression strictly negative at the inclusive cutoff.

claims.title: Exact declaration contract
claims.statement: The one-shot campaign compiles an immutable external contract that checks the scalar theorem, the modeled candidate theorem, and every Lean declaration cited by this report.
details: The controller independently queries the transitive axioms of each requested declaration and accepts only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

claims.title: Citation-complete document
claims.statement: Every substantive claim card in this HTML and PDF has at least one resolved CMV locator or one resolved Lean declaration citation; Lean links point to copied, line-addressable source pages whose hashes are recorded in citations.json.
details: Document validation is an independent campaign gate and cannot turn a failed Lean gate into a successful proof claim.
